description: This file is a test suite written in TypeScript using Vitest. It tests the behavior of bootstrap warning prompt assembly functions within a project, verifying that bootstrap warnings are correctly retained and formatted in the system prompt.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for verifying bootstrap warning prompt assembly.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertions to verify the generated system prompt contains expected substrings.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines an individual test case checking that bootstrap warnings are preserved after hook prepend.

methods.name: analyzeBootstrapBudget
methods.description: Analyzes bootstrap budget based on provided file stats and limits.

methods.name: buildBootstrapInjectionStats
methods.description: Builds statistics about bootstrap injection, including file info.

methods.name: buildBootstrapPromptWarning
methods.description: Constructs a warning message related to bootstrap prompt truncation.

methods.name: prependBootstrapPromptWarning
methods.description: Prepends a bootstrap prompt warning to a given prompt string.

methods.name: composeSystemPromptWithHookContext
methods.description: Combines the base system prompt with hook context, adding bootstrap warnings.
